messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: pagerduty P-4321 fired for embeddings-service (eu-west-1) — high 5xx rate, >150/min. Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P-4321 :rotating_light:

sara: acking. i'm on it — pulling logs and routes. oncall window til 02:00z.

ops-oncall: note: autopage suppression kicked once earlier for the same route, auto-retry backoff at 60s.

mike: seeing a spike in redis errors in the ingestion path, 5xx correlates with kv-store timeouts. grabbing redis-cli to check.

angela: @sara if you need to handoff i can take after 10m, heads-up i'm on a customer call until then.

sara: quick triage: traffic is normal, error percent by model: embedding-small ~ 8%, embedding-large ~ 22%. requests that hit cache miss paths fail faster.

mike: redis replicas in eu-west-1 show increased blocked clients, replication lag ~120s. running: `redis-cli -h redis-eu-01 INFO` — results look noisy, possible slow disk i/o.

incident-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback to regional read-only pool attempted and failed for 3 instances. Fallback policy: route->readpool then route->us-west.

angela: ok i'm taking over — @sara, i'll keep you posted. i'll open a bridge if we need cross-team. set status to "investigating (ongoing)".

ops-oncall: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) scale up redis-eu-standby (x2), 2) enable temporary routing to readpool-us-west for non-SLA traffic, 3) flip embedding-large to degraded model variant (quantized) to reduce mem pressure.

angela: executed scale-up (aws autoscaling request submitted). `asg/redis-eu-standby` +2 nodes. also toggled routing flag for non-prod traffic via config: `redwood-config set routing.embeddings.allow_us_west_burst true` — will monitor.

mike: monit logs show disk i/o errors on redis-eu-01: `i/o timeout` and `lagging appendonly.aof` — ops ticket to infra created: INF-987.

incident-bot: PAGED: INF-987 created and linked to P-4321.

angela: customer impact: some customers on eu-region saw failed embedding requests and degraded throughput; estimated affected keys ~3% of traffic, top customers: acme-inc (rate-limited) and beta-app (partial errors). notifying cs.

sara: thanks. posting short blurb for status page: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting embeddings in eu-west-1. Mitigations in progress: increased standby nodes and regional routing adjustments. No data loss observed; degraded throughput for some customers."

alex: cross-checking billing/fallback rules — we should ensure requests routed to us-west are properly tagged so cost isn't misattributed to eu allocations. created ticket BILL-45.

mike: infra reports new redis nodes are joining but AOF replay is slow, 1 node still lagging. keeping degraded model switch for high-memory calls.

angela: 10:30 into incident: error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% after scale+routing. continuing to monitor for 30m. handing off to sara for longtail, i'll remain on-call via DMs.

sara: ack handoff. will follow up with post-incident root cause once INF-987/redis team has logs. planned follow-ups: snapshot AOF for analysis, add disk i/o alert rule, review autopage suppression thresholds.

incident-bot: UPDATE: pagerduty P-4321 status: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigated (partial).

angela: marking in-thread notes: actions taken: scaled +2 redis, enabled us-west burst routing for non-SLA, flipped embedding-large -> quantized variant. next steps: infra to replace failing disk on redis-eu-01, follow-up RCA.

ops-oncall: closing note for PD: please attach timeline and runbook links to incident. runbook: https://confluence.example/redwood/runbooks/redis-disk-io.md

sara: closing handoff log. will post postmortem draft by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT P-4321: marked mitigated by angela at 3625001399.
